description: The last day of a procedural term (complaint to the ДПС, lawsuit with or without a prior complaint, appeal), moved past weekends and holidays, days left, whether it has expired and a motion to renew it is needed, with the legal basis, Supreme Court positions and assumptions.

actual_knowledge.description: Day the person actually learned of the decision, if later (returned letter, war) (YYYY-MM-DD).

as_of.description: Date to evaluate on. Default: today in Kyiv (YYYY-MM-DD).

event_date.description: Day the term counts from (receipt of the decision, of the complaint decision, of the court decision) (YYYY-MM-DD).

jurisdiction.description: State whose procedure applies. Only "ua" (Ukraine) for now.

kind.description: court_no_appeal (lawsuit, no complaint: 6 months), court_after_appeal_assessment (after a complaint against a ППР: 1 month), court_after_appeal_other (after a complaint, other decisions: 3 months), court_after_appeal_esv (ЄСВ demand after a complaint: 3 months), complaint_dps (10 working days), complaint_esv (10 days), appeal (30 days).

title: Tax disputes: deadline
